spark: Bangin once led a patrol that left a wounded man to the wolves, and the man lived and has been asking after him

focal.name: Bangin Longshanks
focal.who: A long-legged former patrol sergeant who keeps first watch every night.
focal.backstory: Bangin Longshanks led a border patrol that ran from a wolf pack and left a wounded man behind. Years later, word reached him that the man had lived.
